description: Applies many writes to one collection in a single call: creates, updates and deletes together. Prefer it to repeated create_item or update_item calls when the row count is high; use import_data for a CSV or JSON file and delete_items when deleting by query rather than by id. Not a transaction: the phases run in order (create, update, delete) and a failure partway leaves earlier writes committed, so the result reports what succeeded per phase. validate: true checks the payload against the collection schema before anything is written. This tool writes data and has nothing to do with analyze_relationships, which only inspects the data model.

operations.description: The writes to apply, grouped by phase. Phases run in order: create, then update, then delete. Omit a phase to skip it.

name: bulk_operations
